"As suggested, going forward, let's include the SQL_ID in our requests to the L2/L4 team when asking for query tuning. This will help prevent any back-and-forth questioning and delays in the investigation."

1. Replaced "mention" with "include" for better clarity.
2. Changed "so there is no back and forth questioning" to "This will help prevent any back-and-forth questioning and delays in the investigation" for a more concise and direct phrasing.
